title: EngineCommand
description: Internal adapter envelope. The engine's development game endpoints accept submit_choice, concede and set_priority from a seat; the other operations remain unimplemented. Authentication, authorization and controller lease are server context, never client-selected seats: the engine selects the seat from its seat token.

choice.description: Exactly one option id from the open prompt, one amount per entry of an assign_amounts prompt, a typed name for a choose_name prompt, or since v0.9.12 a batch of attackers or blockers for a declare_attackers or declare_blockers prompt.

batch.description: Since v0.9.12: several of the creatures a declaration's prompt offers, declared (or withdrawn) with one command. The engine checks the whole batch against the open prompt first: every object must be one the prompt offers to declare (withdrawing: one already declared). A batch that fails is refused whole (invalid_batch) and declares nothing. Each is then declared as one given alone is. The batch never confirms the declaration: done stays the seat's own.

objects.description: The creatures, by their object ids in the seat's view, in the order to declare them; none twice.

declare.description: true (the default) to declare them, false to withdraw them.

then.description: The answer to the question the game asks after each declaration (which player, planeswalker or battle an attacker attacks; which attacker a blocker blocks). Left out, the first such question is the seat's, and its answer goes to the rest of the batch. Not with a withdrawal.

priority.description: A change to the seat's priority controls (UI07); settings left out stay as they are. Steps are where the seat stops with an empty stack. full_control stops everywhere; false returns to the default stops. cancel_passes ends a pass at once.
